query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS landrace_terpene_profiles (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  landrace_id INT,
  landrace_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  terpene_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  terpene_category VARCHAR(50),
  concentration_ppm DECIMAL(10,4),
  concentration_percent DECIMAL(8,6),
  relative_abundance DECIMAL(5,2),
  detection_method VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'GC-MS',
  retention_time DECIMAL(8,4),
  peak_area DECIMAL(15,2),
  olfactory_contribution TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  source_reference VARCHAR(255),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (landrace_id) REFERENCES tobacco_landraces(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
